what: codegen, for 00746 (dev backend axis): it adds a field codegen_backend: Option<DevBackend> to blaze_codegen::plan::Profile and Override. Profile and Policy are built as full struct literals outside codegen (blaze-link src/tests/lazy.rs:170; blaze-cargo serve/tests.rs:170, serve/unit/run/tests.rs:28, serve/unit/tests.rs:39, serve/unit/codegen.rs:404 and 417, serve/unit/codegen/tests.rs:21), so the field alone would break those crates. Ask: a coordinated round where codegen adds the field and cargo and link add codegen_backend: None to those literals at once, or permission for codegen to add that one line in each. Then cargo can map codegen-backend = cranelift or stencil onto it in serve/unit/codegen.rs codegen_backend instead of refusing it.
